gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-montagu-slab: Smooth as piping, spaced wide: Bushcraft draws every curve with no weight shift, and its capitals barely rise above the lowercase. Bushcraft handles attitude; Montagu Slab, a classic serif, handles the reading.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-serif-henta: Noto Serif Hentaigana, a text serif, brings open jaws on every curve and a subtle, visible stroke modulation. Noto Serif Hentaigana handles the reading; Bushcraft, with its closed shapes and wide spacing, handles the showing off.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-ovo: Rounded, wide-spaced display letters meet Ovo, whose thin strokes are only slightly lighter than its thick ones. But what stands out most is openness: Bushcraft stays closed, while Ovo leaves its curve terminals spacious.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab, a text serif, shows a visibly gaping c at any size, with tall rounded lowercase forms. Epunda Slab opens up wherever Capture It seals shut, and that open-versus-closed tension is the pair's whole point.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-esteban: Capture It stands towering and nearly sealed, with no swelling where its curves meet the stems. Esteban, a classic serif, reads smoothly across paragraphs, its wide-open e never looking squeezed shut.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-fauna-one: Capture It builds towering, sealed-up letters with no shift from heavy to light inside a stroke. Fauna One, a classic serif, takes over for the reading, with a generous entry into the e.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-faustina: Faustina, a text serif, has an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers and bowls that thin gracefully. Faustina faces Capture It, whose bent-paperclip strokes hold one thickness and nearly close their openings.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-glegoo: Tall, tight, nearly shut: that is Capture It, set against Glegoo, with its big counters and unclosed curves. Glegoo, a text serif, feels like an exhale next to that clenched, towering heading.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-halant: Authoritative on both sides: Capture It towers with tube-like constant lines, while Halant allows a faint but real thick-thin shift. The towering x-height they share is what ties the two together.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-hanuman: Capture It towers, its letters nearly sealed shut. Hanuman, a serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on the s, would read openly and unhurried down a full column.
